notes: Reading the numbers: only DINOv2 small is measurably better than the rest on field_dev (accuracy 0.407, CI 0.375 to 0.438). E1 vs frozen ConvNeXt on field_dev is 'no measurable difference' (accuracy diff -0.028, CI [-0.059, 0.003], McNemar p 0.069), so the fine-tuned E1 model does not beat a frozen ImageNet backbone with a linear head on real photos. All absolute field numbers are low (0.04 to 0.41) against 0.89 to 0.998 on lab_dev. Labels are not reviewed (labels_reviewed false), a single seed, a single untuned head setting (lr 0.001, 30 epochs) for both frozen-backbone systems, and no abstention. XGBoost is near chance on field, not a bug. All images, including field photos, go through a plain 224x224 squash with no EXIF transpose, same for all systems, so rotated phone photos may hurt every system equally. E3 is exempt from the standard_image_metrics requirement per TESTING.md, so top-k and plant-given metrics are absent from these records. The lab_dev acceptance check in the log used --min-n 1000, beyond what the plan names. Prediction files tracked in git contain PlantDoc file paths and probabilities but no image data.
